provenance.verified_on_device: none of these were opened on the phone unless the entry says seen: true
provenance.use: Each entry says what the dialog is, when it appears, what to answer in a test run, and whether it may appear unexpectedly (unexpected: true). The rules the runner acts on stay in fixture-spec.json `dialogs`; an entry here becomes a rule when a run meets it or when it is cheap to meet.
provenance.answer: Safe answer = the one that changes no data. 'wait' = a person acts (handover). 'back' = the Back key. Button texts are English resources.

education.what: TapTargetView overlay, not a dialog: it covers the activity and blocks every other tap
education.when: first visit of a screen, hint by hint (file list, credentials, group, entry, entry edit); once each; state in the app's SharedPreferences file kdbxeducation
education.answer: avoid: precondition 'education off' (Appearance, enable_education_screens_key = false) or pre-seed kdbxeducation; else Back cancels it
education.note: timing is asynchronous (posted from onCreateOptionsMenu). The user-verification hint is missing from the reset list, so 'Reset educational hints' does not reset it.

progress.trigger: every database task: load, save, merge, reload, copy, move, delete
progress.answer: wait until gone (not cancelable; Cancel only when the task allows)

database-changed.trigger: onResume finds that the file's modified time or size changed (an adb push of the fixture while the app held it open; a sync)
database-changed.texts: warning_database_info_changed with old and new date and size; or warning_database_revoked when the file is gone
database-changed.answer: OK (reads the file again; changes nothing)
database-changed.note: Initialize pushes the fixture; the apps are force-stopped first, so it should not appear. If it does, the close step did not work: a system exception.

reload-discards.trigger: a forced reload that would discard local changes

notification-permission.trigger: Android 13+, first database action, permission neither granted nor refused before
notification-permission.answer: Later (Ask opens the system permission dialog)
notification-permission.note: the FP4 runs Android 13: possible on a fresh install

password-encoding.trigger: unlock with a password containing characters outside the encoding

duplicate-uuid.trigger: load fails with a duplicate UUID
duplicate-uuid.answer: Cancel, and report the fixture as broken: a system exception

lock-discard.trigger: Lock button, drawer Lock, or Back-to-lock while the database has unsaved changes
lock-discard.answer: Lock (the fixture is never changed by a run; seeing this means something saved or edited)

discard-changes.trigger: Back or Navigate up in the entry editor when the entry differs from the start

user-verification-device.trigger: Edit, reveal or copy of a protected field, drawer merge or save copy, database settings, when the per-database toggle is on and device credentials are available
user-verification-device.answer: wait: a person acts (rule user-verification, 180 s). Prevented in the fixture by setting the toggle off in Initialize.

user-verification-database.trigger: as above when device-credential verification is off or unavailable
user-verification-database.answer: Cancel, or type test123 and Check only if a scenario needs it

clipboard-first-time.trigger: first tap on the Copy button of a protected field (allow_copy_password_first_time_key defaults to true)
clipboard-first-time.answer: Disable (changes the setting clipboard trust to off, which is the default)
clipboard-first-time.note: relevant to UI-COPY if it is ever built

file-manager.trigger: the system file picker is missing or throws
file-manager.answer: Cancel, and fail: a system exception (no picker, no open)

pro-feature.trigger: choosing a disabled theme or icon pack (only builds with STYLES_DISABLED or ICON_PACKS_DISABLED)
pro-feature.answer: Cancel; not reachable in this build

delete-nodes.trigger: deleting entries or groups, emptying the recycle bin
delete-nodes.answer: Cancel; a run never selects entries for deletion

group-info.trigger: tap on the CURRENT group's breadcrumb (it does not navigate)
group-info.note: a test that taps the breadcrumb for navigation meets this

sort.note: the earlier harvest tapped menu_sort and saw no dialog: not explained; the dialog may take longer than the wait, or the tap missed

group-edit.trigger: add group, edit group, long tap on the current breadcrumb

file-too-big.trigger: adding an attachment above the warning size

set-main-credential.trigger: create a vault; Settings, Change master key

main-credential.trigger: drawer, Merge from, after the file is chosen

unavailable-feature.trigger: turning on biometric or device-credential unlock on a device that lacks it

preference-dialogs.trigger: tapping a database or timeout preference
preference-dialogs.answer: Cancel; a harvest never taps a row inside a category

passkey-unknown-app.trigger: a passkey request from an unknown app

popup-menu.note: the app has no PopupMenu or bottom sheet; the overflow is a popup window

file-picker.answer: pick the file by name; Initialize does this

snackbar-toast.answer: none: they vanish; a test must not depend on them

gaps: Dialogs not yet matched against the fixture-spec `dialogs` table: database-changed, notification-permission, clipboard-first-time, group-info, reload-discards, password-encoding, lock-discard, education overlay.
The 'education off' state is not yet a precondition in environments/cprima-dev.json; it is unverified whether the phone has any hints pending.
None of the app dialogs besides discard-changes and user-verification was opened on the phone.
